items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: and I had Yank Porter on drums.

ctx.x: On base, yeah -- and I had Yank Porter on drums. And I think J.C. might have gone with Cab along that period, but that was my little band in Cafe Society, and it began to change -- after awhile, Big Sid came in on drums in place of Yank Porter, and after Sid, I think Sid might have gone with the Armstrong All Stars or something there, and then J.C. came back with me, J.C. was in my small band.
But all through that period in the Cafe Society, which lasted four years, between the Uptown Cafe and the Downtown, the one in the Village.
